instruction: A freestanding stone fireplace pavilion: a heavy masonry chimney mass with a large arched firebox opening, flanking stone piers, a stepped chimney cap, and a small hearth slab at the base. Rugged stacked-stone blocks, structurally believable.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a stone fireplace pavilion. A freestanding stone fireplace pavilion: a heavy masonry chimney mass with a large arched firebox opening, flanking stone piers, a stepped chimney cap, and a small hearth slab at the base. Rugged stacked-stone blocks, structurally believable. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
